deferred_concerns: Buchanan primitive scope: the staged SecondCoefficientPositivityObstruction primitive (in primitive_proposal.jsonl) must be scope-narrowed at Techne v4.0+ registration time. Per ChatGPT 2026-05-13 analysis: Buchanan 2025 arXiv:2509.15537 ('A condition on the Jones polynomial for a family of positive links') and Buchanan 2023 arXiv:2303.13481 ('A pair of Jones polynomial positivity obstructions') cover second Jones coefficient +/-1 (2025) and +/-1 or +/-2 (2023). The obstruction applies to POSITIVE LINKS / Jones polynomial, NOT generic knots. Without an explicit scope-narrowing field (e.g. applies_to: positive_links_only; condition_family: second_jones_coefficient_pm1_pm2), a downstream Learner could overreach to 'Jones second coefficient decides positivity', which would be exactly the overreach pattern Prometheus exists to catch. Add scope_warning as a required_field at registration time. This concern does NOT block today's ingest — Ergon ingests the block as-is; the scope-narrowing lands at Techne registration.
